purpose: Merge proposal for six natural reading-unit bodies recovered from scan-only PDFs. It records proposed source mappings, source and output hashes, exact registered-card quote checks, and the OCR/normalization commands used without mutating the active source override or generated reading manifest.

ocrRecipe.normalizationSummary: Removed scan covers and recurring page furniture; joined printed line-end hyphenation and unambiguous cross-page sentence continuations; retained headings, notes, tables, figures as textual labels, equations, references, and complete natural-unit endpoints; then applied visually checked, edition-specific OCR corrections.
ocrRecipe.visualVerification: Rendered source pages were inspected against the PDFs, including every registered-quote page, article starts and ends, the Gale-Shapley matrices, the Schultz references, and Blackie print p. 1 for the Schrödinger mismatch.

https://mwolf.pracownicy.uksw.edu.pl/MK/.reason: The recovered Blackie 1928 text is complete, but the registered English card quotation is not present in this edition. Do not activate this mapping until the card wording/evidence or cited edition is corrected.

registeredQuoteVerification.registeredQuote: The extension of our “deferred-acceptance” procedure to the problem of college admissions is straightforward.
In other words, the imagined demand curve has a “corner” at the current price.
Much of what we call consumption constitutes investment in human capital.
Those industries which are returning higher than average rates have too few resources; and those yielding lower than average rates have too many resources.

The usual prescription for quantisation can be substituted by another requirement in which no word about ‘integer numbers’ occurs anymore. Rather, the integreness emerges in the same natural way as, for example, the integreness of the number of knots of a vibrating string.
registeredQuoteVerification.observedSourceText: In this paper I wish to consider, first, the simple case of the hydrogen atom (non-relativistic and unperturbed), and show that the customary quantum conditions can be replaced by another postulate, in which the notion of “whole numbers”, merely as such, is not introduced. Rather when integralness does appear, it arises in the same natural way as it does in the case of the node-numbers of a vibrating string.
registeredQuoteVerification.visualEvidence: Local source PDF p. 10, Blackie print p. 1, §1 opening; visually checked against the scan and independently compared with same-edition OCR.
registeredQuoteVerification.recommendation: Do not activate this source mapping as-is. Either revise the English card, Chinese translation, emphasis spans, and edition note to the actual Blackie wording above, or cite and cache the translation that contains the currently registered wording; then rerun an exact contiguous quote audit.
